stories.title: US-led Luzon corridor in Philippines faces growing scrutiny over real local benefits

en.title: US-led Luzon corridor in Philippines faces growing scrutiny over real local benefits
en.summary: Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. promoted the Luzon Economic Corridor to foreign investors, but protesters outside opposed the US-backed initiative, claiming it exploits the country's resources. The backlash reflects broader concerns about the corridor's benefits to local communities.

en.title: Are Chinese students learning English just to 'tell China's story'?
en.summary: Chinese English textbooks are shifting from Western cultural content to Chinese history and culture, including passages on Qing dynasty thinkers, traditional festivals, and China's aid projects, reflecting a nationwide curriculum overhaul.

en.title: Apple should bear responsibility for Hong Kong iPhone card fraud, lawmaker says
en.summary: A Hong Kong lawmaker argues that Apple should bear responsibility for over 700 unauthorized credit card transactions affecting iPhone users, though he notes the financial losses are expected to be limited.

stories.title: 中新健康｜专家：“主动健康”首先要确立正确健康知识

en.title: Expert: 'Active Health' Requires Establishing Correct Health Knowledge First
en.summary: A cardiologist at a Beijing hospital emphasized that adopting proactive health practices begins with ensuring one's health knowledge is accurate. The expert noted that patients often hold misconceptions about health matters, and that AI tools, while increasingly available, may sometimes provide information based on flawed knowledge.

stories.title: Why Chinese shoppers are ditching supermarkets for small ‘community stores’

en.title: Why Chinese shoppers are ditching supermarkets for small 'community stores'
en.summary: Chinese consumers are shifting to small community stores that offer lower prices than traditional supermarkets while providing wider selection than convenience chains. These new retailers are attracting shoppers seeking affordable grocery options with convenient neighborhood locations.
